verdict.rationale: Tavily documents a web Search endpoint that accepts natural-language queries (e.g. "Who is Leo Messi?"), a latency-vs-relevance control, and an opt-in exact_match flag. None of the evidence describes meaning-based or semantic retrieval, or claims it surfaces results that keyword engines miss. Natural-language queries and relevance tuning are adjacent features, not documented semantic search, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run meaning-based semantic search that finds results keyword engines miss
